card.name: FDA name in opioid REMS sentence
card.fires_on: Mostly the words 'Administration' or the closing ')' of '(FDA)' in the stock opioid REMS sentence 'the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has required a Risk Evaluation...'. Also fires on a few unrelated citation or regulation punctuation and numbers.

modes.label: Opioid REMS sentence
modes.description: The agency name or its closing parenthesis in the standard opioid analgesic REMS statement.
modes.example: MS) To ensure that the benefits of opioid analgesics outweigh the risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA<<)>> has required a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation

modes.label: Legal and regulatory citations
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or digit inside a court or CFR citation.

card.plain: It lights up mainly inside the repeated opioid safety-program sentence naming the FDA, and occasionally in legal citations.
